notes.title: 🐦⭐FIRST BIG CONTENT UPDATE! 6 NEW LEVELS!🏃💨🐕
notes.content:
[u][b]Greetings dodgers![/b][/u]

[list]
[*] We've finally released the Challenges tab on the Level Select screen, which will show you new challenges to unlock and complete. Right now there are 2 new challenges with 3 difficulties each, for a total of 6 new levels and 6 achievements to get, and many more high scores to set!
[*] Challenges are meant to be shorter, harder levels. They are different in that if you die, it will automatically restart. Part of the challenge is completing the short level without dying! We will add more over time!
[*] We've also added an achievement for Epilogue Easy, which previously shared an achievement with the normal difficulty epilogue. This will be awarded retroactively when you start the game next.
[*] Untouchable Mode has been added! This is a checkbox under settings that makes it so you auto-restart a level on hit. No more spamming CTRL-R to get that perfect run, we'll do it for you. This is for those chasing an untouchable high score.
[*] Disable Bullet Time has also been added. Another checkbox found under settings that disables the ability to slow down time. This is for the dodgers who do not want anything slowing down their high scores!
[*] The Temple theme song needed some love, being the shortest (and one of the oldest) tunes in the game. We've doubled the length and added a new instrument!
[*] Some smaller bugfixes, be it sprite overlap or other tweaks.
[/list]

Let us know if you have challenge ideas in our Discord or Steam Discussion pages! Happy dodging!

notes.title: Patch 1.2.2 Hotfix for Audio Bug
notes.content:
There was a bug where the volume sliders would reset themselves to 0 if you reset the level. This would be fixed if you adjusted the sliders, thus saving a new default, but the default original being 0 was a bug, and that is now fixed!

Happy dodging! ːB1ː

notes.title: Patch 1.2.1 Bugfixes and Future Content Planned
notes.content:
Hey folks!

Got a few small bug fixes plus an important one. Turns out the 1000 death achievement wasn't working! Well it is now, thanks for letting us know Alex!

Also, you'll see the level select menu has a new (current not playable) challenges menu, which is where we'll keep all of our future challenge content. These will be shorter than the standard map, and will be focused around a mechanic or idea.

We've got two challenges nearly ready, with 3 difficulties each, but they're not quite ripe, so they're not part of this update. We'll let you know soon when they're released!

notes.title: Update 1.2 Untouchable Leaderboards!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we've added a second leaderboard to each level that shows the fastest completions with 0 touches, so we can show off how Untouchable we are!

Unfortunately this is not retroactive so any touchless scores you've gotten previous are not on this, only future touchless completes will be on this board.

Happy dodging!

notes.title: Update 1.1.1 Retroactive Achievements!
notes.content:
On launch, a typo in our code caused the achievements that were supposed to be awarded on completion of levels, to not be achieved. We fixed that when we noticed it, but that only awarded future level completions with achievements so part of this week's update was writing a script to check everyone's progress and award achievements for any levels that should have gotten them. These will be awarded the next time you play the game.

This patch also include the removal of the cursor being over the gameplay screen, but it appears when you need to click options and other buttons. Please let us know if you notice the cursor is acting funny.

Some UI tweaks and volume adjustments were made as well.

Happy dodging!

notes.title: Update 1.1 New Epilogue Easy Map!
notes.content:
Epilogue Easy has been added, it will be unlocked at the same time as Epilogue, but is an alternate and easy last level for those of us who want to see the end boss fight with an easier level overall. Plus, another leaderboard for us to hunt the best times on!

Plus some minor bugfixing stuff is in this patch.

Happy dodging!

notes.title: 6-3-24 Hotfix (a new (easy) version of Epilogue coming soon!)
notes.content:
More UI fixes, some minor difficulty adjustment in of the easy levels.

Close to finishing an easy version of the epilogue map so it's more in line with the other maps. Will release likely later this week.

Happy dodging!

notes.title: Hotfix 1
notes.content: Fixed some lighting stuff in the Forest level as well as some minor UI things.

notes.title: Another Small Update!
notes.content:
Adjustments to spike hitbox to be more forgiving.
Added a few spikes to level 2 hard and level 1 hard.
Walls are now slippery as to more forgiving in tight areas.
Added a toggle for a WASD shower that shows which key you're pressing!

notes.title: Added some more options!
notes.content: Added Confuse status effect mode for Realm of the Mad God fans looking to practice that, as well as a toggle for lighting effects to help with performance. Plus some bugfixes related to lighting, and saving of data.
